kind.content: Independent, partner-led and deliberately small at the top.
For twenty-six years we have advised the people who own and run companies, not only the companies themselves.
Built by three lawyers who wanted to give straight answers.
Halden & Vorst began in a two-room office on the Amstel with three partners and one rule: the client should always know who is responsible, what it will cost and what we honestly think.

Twenty-six years later we are forty people across Amsterdam and London. We have stayed deliberately small at the top. Every matter still has a partner's name on it, and every fee is still agreed before the work begins.
